title: us-evolution-education-lpm Coherence-Analysis Finding Record
description: One empirical finding from directly comparing official documents ACROSS two or more of florida-lpm/pennsylvania-lpm/tennessee-lpm -- this repo's own central use for coherence-finding-record, distinct from any single state repo's own within-state comparisons. The computable unit underneath prose in docs/source-notes/ -- lets a query ask 'how does Florida's current posture on evolution content compare to Pennsylvania's and Tennessee's' or 'does a US Supreme Court ruling's own holding get reflected in a specific state's later statute text'. Modeled on deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's/india-lpm's/florida-lpm's/pennsylvania-lpm's/tennessee-lpm's coherence-finding-record.schema.json; findingType's 'cross-state-standards-divergence' value existed in the shared schema from florida-lpm's own founding but had never actually been used in a real record until this repo -- the whole point of a national-level repo is to be the natural home for that comparison, rather than it living awkwardly inside any one state's own file.

findingType.description: 'uncrossreferenced-gap' = no link found between related content in two policy objects that would benefit from one. 'working-crossreference' = a real cross-reference was found and confirmed. 'standard-wording-change-across-editions' = inherited, not expected to be used here (this repo has no single state's own standard re-adopted across editions -- see florida-lpm/tennessee-lpm for that use). 'standard-naming-explicitness-gap' = whether a given statute/standard names a contested concept explicitly at all -- usable here comparing how explicitly a Supreme Court ruling's own language names 'evolution'/'creationism' versus a later state statute's softer language. 'district-vs-state-standard-divergence' = inherited from pennsylvania-lpm, not expected to be used here. 'litigation-finding-vs-standard-text' = this repo's second central use: whether a specific holding from Epperson v. Arkansas or Edwards v. Aguillard is reflected, contradicted, or simply untested against a specific state's own later statute (e.g. whether Tennessee's 2012 law's careful avoidance of religious language is a legible response to Edwards' own reasoning). 'convergent-coverage-pattern' = 2+ independent sources converge on the same content emphasis. 'cross-state-standards-divergence' = this repo's FIRST central use -- a direct, real comparison of Florida's, Pennsylvania's, and Tennessee's own current postures on evolution-education policy, side by side, the comparison none of those three repos' own self-contained files can make about themselves.

objects.description: The policy object(s) this finding is about. One object alone is valid for a single-source placement fact that a later finding might compare against; most findings compare 2+ (e.g. the same benchmark across two editions).

policyArea.description: e.g. 'Epperson v. Arkansas (1968) holding on teaching-ban statutes', 'Florida's 2026 proposed standards, evolution-naming posture', 'Tennessee's 2012 Teacher Protection Act wording'.

excerptText.description: A short verbatim excerpt grounding the object, where one exists in the source doc.

accessTier.description: How much of this object's source document this record actually keeps in excerptText, chosen per-source based on what's legally safe to redistribute for this document -- not one all-or-nothing repo-wide rule. Identical field to deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's/india-lpm's coherence-finding-record.schema.json.

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal basis for storing excerptText at the accessTier chosen above. Mirrors OpenLPM's standards_documents.license_or_rights_note field (openlpm migration 019) for ecosystem-wide naming consistency.

summary.description: One or two sentences stating the finding in plain language -- what was found, not why it matters (see policyRelevance for that).

policyRelevance.description: Optional: why this finding matters for curriculum policy or for OpenEvo's own strategy, if not already obvious from summary.

testsMandateIds.description: Institutional-mandate-record ids this finding provides evidence for, against, or relevant to.

relatedControversyIds.description: policy-controversy-record ids this finding provides direct textual evidence for -- e.g. a wording-change finding that documents exactly what a controversy's contestedObjects fight was actually about.

themes.description: Which content theme(s) this finding is evidentially about -- kept as an open, non-enum string list since this repo's theme taxonomy has not yet stabilized.

exhaustivenessCaveat.description: Explicit statement of how exhaustive the underlying search was, e.g. 'based on the specific editions and benchmark codes fetched this session, not a systematic benchmark-by-benchmark diff of every life-science standard across all four editions' -- required honesty; omit only when a search genuinely was exhaustive (rare).
